column11: note
Target unbolds only see. Main rewraps see, so the word stays bold.
Target unbolds only docs. Main leaves the whole phrase bold.
Target closes bold before now. Main keeps now bold.
Same last-word edge as m3-unbold-last, with a 4-byte emoji in the phrase.
Space at the end of the bold link text stays inside the link. Main bytes.
The letter after that space stays inside the link and keeps the URL. Main bytes.
A letter with no space first keeps the URL. Main bytes.
Target drops bold and keeps the URL. Main keeps bold and the URL.
Italic on the link text keeps bold and the URL. Main bytes.
Whole-word bold off leaves italic. Main bytes.
Whole-word italic off leaves bold. Main bytes.
Target unbolds end and keeps the image. Main keeps the image but not the unbold.

Italic on c keeps
and bold. Main bytes.
Italic on c keeps the backslash escape. Main bytes.
Target unbolds now and keeps the link. Main keeps the link but not the unbold.
Target unbolds now and keeps the underline on docs. Main keeps the tag but not the unbold.
Target drops bold on ell only and keeps italic and underline. Main keeps bold.
Target splits the code span: He is code, llo is bold code. Main leaves asterisks in the code text.
Target splits the code span: ell is code, H and o are bold code. Main leaves asterisks in the code text.
Target keeps H and o bold+italic and ell italic, using asterisks so the glued x does not break the span. Main shows raw stars.
Target is underscore emphasis around the split word, display Hello, ell italic only. Main shows raw stars.
A space before the span lets underscore emphasis open. Main shows raw stars.
Partial unbold of He leaves He italic and llo bold+italic, caret on He. Main leaves He bold.
X replaces He and stays italic. Main leaves X bold.
Partial unbold of a bold word. Main shows raw stars.
X replaces the unbolded He. Main shows raw stars.
Target adds italic to llo (still bold) and to wo, with no raw markers. The caret covers llo through wo. Main leaks markers.
Correct target, not main: the selection starts in the bold word and ends in the next plain word, so X is plain and He stays bold. Main leaves raw markers in **He*X*rld.
Main bytes: Left moves to offset 0, before the bold markers, so Ctrl+B unwraps the word and the following x is plain.
Collapsed link toggle at the start of the word removes the link and leaves a caret. Main bytes.
Collapsed link toggle in the middle of the word removes the link and leaves a caret. Main bytes.
The letter after a middle unlink inserts into the word. Main bytes.
Collapsed link toggle at the end of the word removes the link and leaves a caret. Main bytes.
Italic across the line break. Bytes have the intended flags. The caret is main's source range over that selection.
Correct target, not main: the selection crosses the line break into plain wor, so X is plain and He stays bold. Main eats the closers and leaves **HeXld.
Enter inside the bold phrase closes and reopens bold on each line. Main splits the markers.
Shift+Enter should use the same repair as Enter. Main splits the markers.
Enter in the bold cell should keep bold on first and on half. Main splits the markers. Table display_text keeps the raw line; hidden ranges cover the asterisks.
Enter inside nested italic closes and reopens bold and italic. Main tears the inner span.
Trailing space is tested only by the letter that follows it. Main bytes: foo stays bold and bar x stays bold and italic.
Undo of Enter restores the phrase and puts the caret back at the split. Main bytes.
Left and right return to the same place, so one undo clears hello. Main bytes.
Undo of hello with no motion clears the note. Main bytes.
